title_zh: 选择少压薄荷的鸡尾酒

scenario.label_zh: 选择少压薄荷的鸡尾酒
scenario.goal_zh: 说明薄荷口味偏好并确定鸡尾酒的调制方式

context_zh: 两位成年人在酒吧点一杯鸡尾酒。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: I'd like the lime cocktail, but could you go easy on the mint?

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.text: Certainly. Shall I leave it out completely?

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: No, a little is nice. It gets too strong when you crush a whole handful of leaves.

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.text: Then I'll use two leaves and press them gently rather than crushing them.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: That sounds right. I'll have it that way, please.
